supersedes.retention_policy: v1 remains immutable audit history; v2 is the effective addendum

authorization.basis: After reviewing the independent Antigravity audit, the user instructed Codex to apply the valid corrections and continue on 2026-09-01.

adopted_corrections.density_monopole_gauge: The N32 technical z=0 latent must remove or explicitly fix the spatial mean of eta before alpha_p is applied. No actual-field inference may begin with an unconstrained eta monopole.
adopted_corrections.alpha_prior: Each of six alpha_p parameters requires an external luminosity-function/selection calibration prior; the observed population totals may be data but may not define the prior center through exposure renormalization.
adopted_corrections.full_sky_RSD: The RSD operator must use the observer-centered position-dependent line of sight rhat(x). A plane-parallel or one-axis distant-observer approximation is forbidden.
adopted_corrections.RSD_deposition: NGP applies only to observed integer count construction. The predicted continuous intensity may and generally should use a differentiable mass-conserving deposition kernel with a tested adjoint; predicted lambda is not an integer.
adopted_corrections.low_exposure_label: Every posterior field voxel must carry exposure/information diagnostics. ZoA and other mock-demonstrated unconstrained regions must be labeled prior_dominated rather than observationally reconstructed.
adopted_corrections.boundary_policy: Before Phase B, predeclare padding, radial support, periodic-image suppression, and operator tests for the observer-centered sphere embedded in the periodic box.
adopted_corrections.overdispersion_scale_dependence: Poisson is the N32 baseline only. HOD or negative-binomial alternatives must be decided on development mocks before increasing spatial resolution.
adopted_corrections.holdout_semantics: The frozen recno hash is a reproducible pseudo-random row split. Conditional on the realized split it is a predictive partition, not a claim of mathematically exact independent Poisson experiments.
adopted_corrections.overlap_semantics: The 17,007-target exclusion removes direct same-object reuse. It does not erase shared cosmic-field dependence or every catalog-level systematic covariance; conditional factorization and posterior predictive residual checks remain required.

rejected_or_corrected_audit_statements.Fisher_normalization: Normalizing expected counts to observed population totals was an explicit datum-free Fisher sensitivity convention, not by itself a fatal error. It is forbidden as the actual Poisson intensity because it would condition away population-normalization information.
rejected_or_corrected_audit_statements.invented_numerical_thresholds: The Antigravity suggestions gradient 1e-4, RSD conservation 1e-6, Rhat 1.05, zero divergences, r(k) 0.7, and residual ratio 0.5 are not adopted or frozen by this addendum.
rejected_or_corrected_audit_statements.observational_k_estimate: The suggested generic k range 0.2--0.5 h/Mpc is not a project result and may not be quoted as the recovered frontier.
rejected_or_corrected_audit_statements.complete_covariance_removal: The disjoint-object rule does not prove all CF4/2M++ observational errors independent.

effective_Phase_A_contract.purpose: Build the first actual datum-bearing six-population 2M++ count artifact without performing inference.
effective_Phase_A_contract.observed_count_assignment: one NGP/floor voxel per retained catalog row, integer int64 counts
effective_Phase_A_contract.selection: raw official angular times Schechter radial exposure, integrated with eight Gauss subpoints per N32 voxel and never normalized to observed totals
effective_Phase_A_contract.split: deterministic SHA256 recno thinning with a frozen salt and nominal 4/5 train, 1/5 holdout fractions before voxelization
hard_failure_if: the retained count or any of six population totals differs from the frozen values
counts_all differs elementwise from counts_train plus counts_holdout
a positive observed count lies in a voxel with nonpositive raw exposure
retained and excluded recnos are not disjoint
the output or staging directory already exists

Phase_B_entry_amendments_required: freeze the eta monopole/gauge implementation and alpha priors
define observer-centered spherical RSD including boundary handling and a differentiable deposition/adjoint pair
freeze directional-gradient and mass-conservation tolerances from implementation precision analysis before seeing mock results

unchanged_science_policy.IC_role: downstream physical closure after z=0 mock validation
